hypotheses.justification: For any morphism g from a reduced scheme, the individual kernel equality holds without quasi-compactness. Put Z = closure(range g) and I = vanishingIdeal Z. The lemma Hom.range_subset_ker_support and closedness of support give Z ≤ g.ker.support; le_support_iff_le_vanishingIdeal then gives g.ker ≤ I. Conversely, every section s ∈ I.ideal U has basic open disjoint from Z, using coe_support_vanishingIdeal, mem_support_iff and mem_zeroLocus_iff. Thus Scheme.preimage_basicOpen shows that the basic open of g.app U s is empty. Reducedness and eq_zero_of_basicOpen_eq_bot imply g.app U s = 0. By Hom.ker's definition and le_ofIdeals_iff, this gives I ≤ g.ker. Apply this equality to each f j and retain the existing vanishingIdeal_iSup argument. Empty sources cause no exception; for empty J, both sides are top by vanishingIdeal_bot.
